review: Prompt 48 finite read-load plan and capture checker
scope: Read-only source and evidence review plus authorized host checker/test correction. No hardware or Git mutations by reviewer.
campaign_plan: plan.json is the lead-owned authorization/configuration record; this review does not mark campaigns executed.

campaigns_reviewed.purpose: Compare diagnostic output overhead at the same read cadence
Compare higher offered read load at the same summary cadence

bounds: Use --reads full --max-trials 1 --reenumerate-s 0 --keepalive-s 0 and new output directories. Default max-trials 3 permits new trials after lost port/reset and is unsuitable here.
s2_soak.py floors remaining wall seconds before emitting S. Compare the recorded request and SOAK_BEGIN dur, which can be 599/119 seconds for the 600/120 second host requests.

At duration D seconds and interval I milliseconds, no more than ceil(1000*D/I)-1 schedule ticks occur, because the first is one interval after begin and no tick starts at or after duration. Busy/dump conditions can reduce admission; there is no catch-up burst.

One operation runs at a time, alternating nodes. full requests nine identity uploads once per node, then alternating four-upload status/feedback and three-upload monitors. Each admitted operation has a 2-second deadline and 250-ms queue/response host policies.
X requests a scheduling stop, allowing the current read to settle. It sends no motor stop. A soak releases ordinary read context internally; it has no r release command.

Firmware finishing allows 10 seconds for an active read/release and then bounded final-output handling. The host waits beyond its wall deadline by max(30,summary_s) before one X, then at most 30 seconds more. Capture bounds are not vendor response or stop guarantees.

The 11008-byte lazy Soak allocation is persistent. A boot with P47 shared console and both motion contexts retained had only 2880 free bytes/largest1024; the lead must establish the fresh boot and allocate Soak before those consumers.
acceptance: Match USB identity, exact running base/ELF/SDK, sent S fields, trial identifier and observed duration. Do not infer the flashed image from repository HEAD.

Require SOAK_END reason=duration for A/B/C and settled=1; require complete final SOAK_SUM/GAP/CON and NODE/HIST/OUT/ABORT for both nodes. Inspect errors, malformed bytes and numbering gaps independently.

Require each node to execute reads, ops==opsOk, opsFail==0, refused==0, steps==stepsOk, stopped==0, and consistent outcome/histogram totals. The checker intentionally permits valid zero-read short or explicitly stopped captures, so complete alone is not campaign coverage.

Compare owner/TWAI error and loss counter deltas with baseline, including txRej/rxDrop/rxLost/unmatched/qRej/resFull/timeouts/cancelled/busOff/recov/twaiErr/twaiFlags/twaiDrop/trOver/netDrop/tec/rec. Preserve existing lifetime counts rather than treating every nonzero value as a new event.
Review evFull/evLimit/dumpAb/trLost and raw anomaly budgets; complete numbered output does not establish that no event was suppressed before formatting.
Record both node latency histograms/min/mean/max, retireMax, earlyReply, resource high-water marks and service gaps. Report the measured load and observation window; no universal bound follows.

Run s2_console_account.py on every complete raw capture. Inspect marked interleaving windows and missing tails rather than treating a byte balance as content or electrical proof. Any new anomaly is reviewed before a separately chosen next trial.

counter_meanings.SOAK_NODE_min_mean_max: Owner admission to terminal, only terminals with possible transmission; includes scheduling/queue/transport/device/processing time, not isolated device or wire latency.
counter_meanings.SOAK_HIST: Upper endpoints 2,5,10,20,50,100,250 ms; eighth bucket above250ms.
counter_meanings.SOAK_GAP_gapMax_gapWin: Soak service gap in the trial and since prior summary; ownerGap is owner lifetime maximum. Stack is task lifetime least-free; heap is current and heapMin lifetime minimum.
counter_meanings.SOAK_CON_blocked: Turns a whole formatted line waited for UART-queue space, not a lost CAN frame.
counter_meanings.SOAK_CON_conRej: Output queue submission refusals since boot from all writers; soak checks space before submitting. Prior route retries can leave a nonzero baseline.
counter_meanings.SOAK_CON_defBusy_slips: Due read waits and skipped schedule ticks; expected when offered interval is shorter than an operation. Neither is by itself a failure.
counter_meanings.SOAK_CON_evFull_evLimit: Dropped application event records due to capacity or value rate limit.
counter_meanings.SOAK_CON_dumpAb_trLost_dumpUs_defDump: Abandoned dump count, missing dump entries, time/ticks reads were held for diagnostic dumps; these describe diagnostic impact.
counter_meanings.SOAK_CON_uartBytes_queued: UART FIFO-accepted bytes modulo2^32 and bytes still queued at formatting. Sum gives stream position unless another writer interleaves before admission.
counter_meanings.submitOverwritten: Tap single-submission record replacements since boot; earlier non-soak requests can cause a fixed baseline. A delta during soak needs investigation.

raw_evidence_limits: Soak retains an overwriting128-entry software trace, at most96 entries per anomaly dump, two dumps per kind and16 per trial. It is not continuous full CAN traffic capture. Separate ordinary pre/post traced public reads provide exact samples only for those operations.
UART byte-account shortfall in an unmarked valid window localizes loss after uart_tx_chars FIFO acceptance. It cannot choose among S2 UART output, wire, bridge, USB and host driver.
A GPIO43 receive-only independent115200/8N1 capture with receiver errors and clock bounds is required for s2_uart_compare.py to localize further. No such capture is established here.
The 20261106 high-load capture lost1312 bytes after FIFO acceptance despite successful CAN read totals. A new short clean run does not resolve or refute that retained failure.
P47 heartbeat producer1017=0 and event timers0 supplied no periodic heartbeat/PDO load. Read load cannot establish host-loss stop, TPDO congestion or electrical behavior.
host_interruption: SIGINT in s2_soak.py sets interrupted and sends X while continuing capture; it tests graceful host-requested scheduling stop, not disappearance.

A planned gap in host reading on one retained connection tests capture buffering only; no flow control means it need not stall firmware UART. Retain exact pause duration and received bytes; do not call it CAN link loss.

An actual host-close experiment must be separately named, finite and read-only, with automatic reconnection disabled. Preserve its incomplete capture and firmware duration. Any later inspection is a new explicit observation, never replay or recovery of the original request.
s2_bench_console.py admits only its listed bench bytes and @/T lines; it does not admit S or X. Use an already reviewed single-owner capture path rather than inventing supported helper commands.

checker_correction.original_reproduction: SOAK_BEGIN dur60 and SOAK_END up8950 settled0 with no summary returned complete.
checker_correction.replacement: Missing/latest incomplete final summary is incomplete; final summary predating duration or an observed stop is incomplete; duration end earlier than declared bound is inconsistent; unsettled/internal/final-node failure is retained failed-evidence.
checker_correction.native_limit: Native requestStop may emit no SOAK_STOPPING. In that case the format alone cannot distinguish an earlier complete periodic group from the final group of a stopped trial; no timing proof is fabricated.
checker_correction.not_a_workload_verdict: A complete short duration or explicit stop may have zero reads. Campaign acceptance remains separate.

checker_correction.independent_review: p48_source_audit independently reviewed firmware end ordering, current diff, 118/41 tests and historical verdicts; no remaining finding.
